annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1958 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 with regard to intelligent speed assistance systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1958 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 with regard to intelligent speed assistance systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 409/1
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation setting test procedures and technical requirements for type-approval of intelligent speed assistance (ISA) systems in motor vehicles, including camera, map and machine-learning inputs. It includes a catalogue of national road signs, real-world reliability tests, privacy limits, update obligations, and data reporting to the Commission. The driver remains responsible.
key_provisions_or_claims: ISA systems must meet performance requirements for type-approval as vehicle systems or separate technical units
Real-world driving reliability test requires correct speed limit for at least 90% of distance
No biometric use and no continuous recording of speeding data; privacy safeguards
Manufacturers must provide map/software updates (free for 7 years) and keep reliability for 14 years
Manufacturers report ISA usage data via approval authorities to the Commission from July 2024
